decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (799 150 Rev2, received on 01/05/2013, page 24 of the Design and Access Statement titled '3.2 The Sheds Proposals - Elevation 2', and page 25 of the Design and Access Statement titled '3.2 The Sheds Proposals - Elevation 1, 3 & 4', received on 01/05/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until a scheme to protect the warehouses' steel frames has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until an illumination scheme for the warehouses has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Details must include lux levels, direction and screening of any lighting. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Re-clad existing disused warehouses to 4 of the elevations to improve safety, lighting and the condition of the public route along the tow path
